scope: DECISIVE: the non-zero snapshot is rejected because stream_error == 1 at the decision point
probe: Decide at 0x4724A5, recording [esi] (the stream error flag) plus the three fields the cmp chain tests

verdict.conclusion: the rejection is the STREAM ERROR raised during parsing, not a semantic field check

what_this_means: the non-zero playerState body overruns the bit stream while being decoded, so the parser sets the error flag
the earlier 'ps consumed 32 bits' reading was the actors entry point, not the end of a clean decode - the block kept reading past our payload
the all-zero body (single22, 29 bits) decodes cleanly (error 0) and therefore reaches state 10
so the fix is to give the playerState block ROOM: pad zero bits inside the ps before the exit bit so the decode can finish without running off the end
next: rebuild nz1 with extra zero padding inside the ps block (e.g. +20, +40 bits) and re-run the Decide probe
the run is successful in the diagnostic sense when stream_error == 0 at 0x4724A5; that is now a direct oracle instead of inferring from client state
